name: Kajuu Sentai ☆ Fruits Ranger
original_name: 果汁戦隊☆フルーツレンジャー
source:
The heroine, Peach, is captured by the evil organization P☆TT and brought to their secret hideout.
Forced into the center of an arena teeming with enemy fighters, she confronts Strawberry Corn, the Overlord of P☆TT.

"I'll have you tortured and killed. Your body will serve as an inspiration for my many underlings."
"Heh. Should've expected nothing less from a demented freak show like this."
Peach replies sarcastically to calm herself, but here she has no weapons or comrades.
With no hope of rescue, her inner anxiousness only increases.
That's when the Overlord makes an offer.
"Pick one of the three minions I've prepared. If you survive the fight, then I shall spare your life."
Peach doubts the honesty of these words, but she has no other way to survive.
"I'll play your game. I'm not going down without putting up a fight!"
The conditions are bad, but Peach accepts his proposal.

Don't miss a beat. It's payback time!

[Adapted from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/torp_0006english/]DMM.R18[/url]]
translation:
女主角桃子被邪恶组织P☆TT抓走，带到了他们的秘密据点。
她被迫站在挤满敌方战士的竞技场中央，面对P☆TT的霸王草莓玉米。

“我要把你折磨至死。你的身体将成为激励我众多手下的榜样。”
“呵，面对你这种疯狂的畸形秀，我早该料到会有这一套。”
桃子用讥讽来让自己冷静，可此刻的她没有武器，也没有同伴。
救援无望，内心的不安不断加剧。
就在这时，霸王提出了一个条件。
“从我准备的三个部下中选一个。如果你能在战斗中活下来，我就饶你一命。”
桃子怀疑他是否会信守承诺，但除此之外别无生路。
“我接受你的游戏。不到最后一刻，我绝不会认输！”
条件对她极为不利，但桃子接受了提议。

精彩好戏不容错过。复仇时刻到了！

[改编自[url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/torp_0006english/]DMM.R18[/url]]
